definitions.gloss: desperate, strenuous, with all one's might
definitions.explanation: Putting maximum effort into something; trying one's hardest.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}に⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}っている→養う：04478_yashinau⟧。
examples.english: I work hard to support my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧{懸命|けんめい}⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: He studied with all his might.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}った→実る：00282_minoru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいた→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: The children were swimming as hard as they could.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：01900_ouen⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{上|あ}げた→張り上げる：29268_hariageru⟧。
examples.english: I shouted with all my might to cheer for the team.

notes:
{懸命|けんめい} means putting all one's effort into something.

Key expression:
- ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧{懸命|けんめい} (with all one's might, desperately)
  - Very common set phrase
  - Originally ⟦{一所|いっしょ}→一所：02848_issho⟧{懸命|けんめい} (staking one's life on one place/position)

Common collocations:
- {懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work desperately hard)
- {懸命|けんめい}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (strenuous efforts)
- {懸命|けんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧ (to appeal desperately)

Related terms:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧ (desperate, frantic)
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧ (full power, with all one's strength)
- ⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧ (eager, enthusiastic)
